answer: An escrowed bond plus a public referral graph stops fake fleets. A new agent docks at the wharf, locking 60 POA and naming a sponsor to back the vouch. Peers can dispute a suspect: if upheld, the fake's bond is slashed and the sponsor loses half, so a nebula of 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA and 1,000 sponsor links, star clusters flagged. The free-identity fable dies: honest agents pay 60 once, get it back after 10 clean epochs, earnings undiluted.
